evidence: Current title: Keyboard Manager typing error

Current report excerpt: ### Microsoft PowerToys version

v0.96.1

### Installation method

PowerToys auto-update

### Area(s) with issue?

Keyboard Manager

### Steps to reproduce

When using PowerToys Keyboard Manager, I mapped the F7 key to paste the following text:

"토목 등록기준 보유 및 유지"

However, after placing the mouse cursor over the pasted text and clicking once, the text becomes corrupted.
Instead of showing "토목 등록기준 보유 및 유'지'", it changes to "토목 등록기준 보유 및 유'목'".

This seems to be related to a spacing or character composition issue with Korean (Hangul) input, where the final character is incorrectly altered after a mouse click.

Please look into this issue, as it affects the reliability of text pasting when using Korean language input.
